registry_correction: NA: Income Tax Act 24 of 1981 confirmed; rates in Schedule 4 (Act 4 of 2024: 0 % to N$100 000, then 18/25/28/30/32/37 %), no rebate; spouses separate; year ending last day of February.
headline: Namibia built from the Income Tax Act (Global law, Act 4 of 2024 schedule): N$100 000 zero band, 18-37 %; bank interest bears a final 10 % (s. 34A) and dividends are exempt, so N$100 000 of interest instead of wages saves N$27 000 and of dividends N$37 000 at the top rate.
